// Fixture-Generator: erzeugt Go-App-Daten (Schema v5) für die Rust-Tests.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"nunc/internal/db"
	"nunc/internal/models"
	"nunc/internal/services"
)

const deviceA = "fixture-device-a"
const deviceB = "fixture-device-b"

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

type todoSpec struct {
	raw         string
	syncID      string
	updatedAt   string
	pomodoros   int
	completed   bool
	completedAt string
	createdAt   string
	deleted     bool
}

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	dbPath := filepath.Join(out, "go-v5.db")
	_ = os.Remove(dbPath)
	_ = os.Remove(dbPath + "-wal")
	_ = os.Remove(dbPath + "-shm")

	d, err := db.OpenDB(dbPath)
	must(err)

	settings, err := services.NewSettingsService(d)
	must(err)
	s := settings.Get()
	s.PomodoroMin = 30
	s.ShortBreakMin = 6
	s.LongBreakAfter = 3
	s.SoundVolume = 55
	s.FlowtimeRatio = 0.25
	s.FlowtimeMinFlowStateMin = 20
	s.LastBackupDate = "2026-09-29"
	s.SyncProvider = "webdav"
	must(settings.Save(s))
	_, err = settings.GetOrCreateDeviceID()
	must(err)
	_, err = d.Exec(`UPDATE settings SET value = ? WHERE key = 'device_id'`, deviceA)
	must(err)

	todos := services.NewTodoService(d)
	specs := []todoSpec{
		{raw: "(A) 2026-09-20 Write quarterly report +work @desk", syncID: "t-0001", updatedAt: "2026-09-28T09:00:00Z", pomodoros: 5, createdAt: "2026-09-20"},
		{raw: "(B) 2026-09-21 Call dentist @phone", syncID: "t-0002", updatedAt: "2026-09-27T16:30:00Z", pomodoros: 1, createdAt: "2026-09-21"},
		{raw: "2026-09-22 Buy groceries +home @errands", syncID: "t-0003", updatedAt: "2026-09-22T08:00:00Z", createdAt: "2026-09-22"},
		{raw: "x 2026-09-25 2026-09-18 Plan sprint +work", syncID: "t-0004", updatedAt: "2026-09-25T17:00:00Z", pomodoros: 3, completed: true, completedAt: "2026-09-25", createdAt: "2026-09-18"},
		{raw: "(C) Read Rust book +learning +rust @evening", syncID: "t-0005", updatedAt: "2026-09-24T20:00:00Z", pomodoros: 2},
		{raw: "Old idea that was deleted", syncID: "t-0006", updatedAt: "2026-09-23T12:00:00Z", deleted: true},
	}
	var added []models.Todo
	for _, sp := range specs {
		t, err := todos.Add(sp.raw)
		must(err)
		added = append(added, t)
		if sp.completed {
			_, err = todos.SetCompleted(t.ID, true)
			must(err)
		}
		deleted := 0
		if sp.deleted {
			deleted = 1
		}
		_, err = d.Exec(`UPDATE todos SET raw_text=?, sync_id=?, updated_at=?, pomodoro_count=?, deleted=?,
			created_at=NULLIF(?, ''), completed_at=NULLIF(?, '') WHERE id=?`,
			sp.raw, sp.syncID, sp.updatedAt, sp.pomodoros, deleted, sp.createdAt, sp.completedAt, t.ID)
		must(err)
	}

	type sess struct {
		mode, typ, status, start, end string
		planned, actual, brk          int
		todo                          int
	}
	sessions := []sess{
		{"pomodoro", "work", "completed", "2026-09-22T09:00:00Z", "2026-09-22T09:30:00Z", 30, 30, 6, 1},
		{"pomodoro", "short_break", "completed", "2026-09-22T09:30:00Z", "2026-09-22T09:36:00Z", 6, 6, 0, 0},
		{"pomodoro", "work", "completed", "2026-09-22T09:40:00Z", "2026-09-22T10:10:00Z", 30, 30, 6, 1},
		{"pomodoro", "work", "aborted", "2026-09-23T14:00:00Z", "2026-09-23T14:08:00Z", 30, 8, 0, 2},
		{"pomodoro", "work", "completed", "2026-09-24T08:00:00Z", "2026-09-24T08:30:00Z", 30, 30, 6, 1},
		{"pomodoro", "work", "completed", "2026-09-25T10:00:00Z", "2026-09-25T10:30:00Z", 30, 30, 6, 4},
		{"pomodoro", "work", "completed", "2026-09-25T10:36:00Z", "2026-09-25T11:06:00Z", 30, 30, 25, 4},
		{"pomodoro", "long_break", "skipped", "2026-09-25T11:06:00Z", "2026-09-25T11:10:00Z", 25, 4, 0, 0},
		{"flowtime", "work", "completed", "2026-09-26T09:00:00Z", "2026-09-26T09:50:00Z", 0, 50, 12, 1},
		{"flowtime", "work", "completed", "2026-09-27T13:00:00Z", "2026-09-27T13:12:00Z", 0, 12, 0, 5},
		{"flowtime", "work", "completed", "2026-09-28T09:00:00Z", "2026-09-28T10:00:00Z", 0, 60, 15, 1},
	}
	for _, x := range sessions {
		var todo any
		if x.todo != 0 {
			todo = x.todo
		}
		_, err = d.Exec(`INSERT INTO sessions (mode, session_type, status, started_at, ended_at, planned_min, actual_min, todo_id, break_min, sync_device_id)
			VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`, x.mode, x.typ, x.status, x.start, x.end, x.planned, x.actual, todo, x.brk, deviceA)
		must(err)
	}
	_, err = d.Exec(`UPDATE schema_migrations SET applied_at = '2026-09-01 00:00:00'`)
	must(err)
	_, err = d.Exec(`PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`)
	must(err)
	must(d.Close())

	// Sync-Datei von Gerät A (Format wie sync.go/sync_webdav.go, MarshalIndent)
	var syncTodos []models.SyncTodo
	for i, sp := range specs {
		t := added[i]
		completedAt := sp.completedAt
		syncTodos = append(syncTodos, models.SyncTodo{
			SyncID: sp.syncID, DeviceID: deviceA, RawText: sp.raw, Priority: t.Priority,
			Completed: sp.completed, CompletedAt: completedAt, CreatedAt: sp.createdAt,
			Description: t.Description, ProjectTags: nz(t.ProjectTags), ContextTags: nz(t.ContextTags),
			PomodoroCount: sp.pomodoros, Position: i + 1, UpdatedAt: sp.updatedAt, Deleted: sp.deleted,
		})
	}
	var syncSessions []models.SyncSession
	for _, x := range sessions {
		syncSessions = append(syncSessions, models.SyncSession{
			DeviceID: deviceA, Mode: x.mode, SessionType: x.typ, Status: x.status,
			StartedAt: x.start, EndedAt: x.end, PlannedMin: x.planned, ActualMin: x.actual, BreakMin: x.brk,
		})
	}
	write(filepath.Join(out, "nunc-sync.json"), models.SyncFile{
		SchemaVersion: 1, SyncedAt: mustTime("2026-09-29T07:00:00Z"), DeviceID: deviceA,
		Todos: syncTodos, Sessions: syncSessions,
	})

	// WebDAV-Sync-Datei von Gerät B: Konflikte (t-0002 neuer, t-0003 älter), neues Todo, gelöschtes Todo, neue Sessions
	b := []models.SyncTodo{
		{SyncID: "t-0002", DeviceID: deviceB, RawText: "(A) 2026-09-21 Call dentist tomorrow @phone", Priority: "A", CreatedAt: "2026-09-21", Description: "Call dentist tomorrow", ProjectTags: []string{}, ContextTags: []string{"@phone"}, PomodoroCount: 1, Position: 2, UpdatedAt: "2026-09-29T08:00:00Z"},
		{SyncID: "t-0003", DeviceID: deviceB, RawText: "2026-09-22 Buy groceries", CreatedAt: "2026-09-22", Description: "Buy groceries", ProjectTags: []string{}, ContextTags: []string{}, Position: 3, UpdatedAt: "2026-09-21T08:00:00Z"},
		{SyncID: "t-0005", DeviceID: deviceB, RawText: "(C) Read Rust book +learning +rust @evening", Priority: "C", Description: "Read Rust book", ProjectTags: []string{"+learning", "+rust"}, ContextTags: []string{"@evening"}, PomodoroCount: 2, Position: 5, UpdatedAt: "2026-09-29T09:00:00Z", Deleted: true},
		{SyncID: "t-0100", DeviceID: deviceB, RawText: "2026-09-29 Water the plants @home", CreatedAt: "2026-09-29", Description: "Water the plants", ProjectTags: []string{}, ContextTags: []string{"@home"}, Position: 7, UpdatedAt: "2026-09-29T06:30:00Z"},
	}
	bs := []models.SyncSession{
		{DeviceID: deviceB, Mode: "pomodoro", SessionType: "work", Status: "completed", StartedAt: "2026-09-29T06:00:00Z", EndedAt: "2026-09-29T06:25:00Z", PlannedMin: 25, ActualMin: 25, BreakMin: 5},
		{DeviceID: deviceB, Mode: "pomodoro", SessionType: "short_break", Status: "completed", StartedAt: "2026-09-29T06:25:00Z", EndedAt: "2026-09-29T06:30:00Z", PlannedMin: 5, ActualMin: 5},
	}
	// eine Session, die Gerät A schon kennt (Duplikat, darf nicht doppelt erscheinen)
	bs = append(bs, syncSessions[0])
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(out, "webdav"), 0o755))
	write(filepath.Join(out, "webdav", "nunc-sync.json"), models.SyncFile{
		SchemaVersion: 1, SyncedAt: mustTime("2026-09-29T09:05:00Z"), DeviceID: deviceB, Todos: b, Sessions: bs,
	})
	fmt.Println("ok")
}

func nz(s []string) []string {
	if s == nil {
		return []string{}
	}
	return s
}

func write(path string, v any) {
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(path, append(data, '\n'), 0o644))
}

func mustTime(v string) time.Time {
	t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v)
	must(err)
	return t
}
